197000.description:
When young Maria is married off to Jacques Redford, a wealthy nobleman, she is grateful that he seems to be gentle and understanding. However, there are dark secrets to be discovered in the Redford estate, and Maria’s life takes a turn for the worse as her husband's sadistic preferences come to light. With no one left to lean on, Maria finds solace in the companionship of Jacques’ illegitimate half-brother, Lowell. Now that Lowell has returned home as a war hero, can he save Maria from her cruel fate?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: 義弟よ、夫の歪んだ愛から解放して
จูบรักจรดปลายเท้า

title.english: The Demon Who Kisses My Foot

197001.description:
Whenever a man lies to Haohao, he turns into a dog in her eyes. One day, she meets a shapeshifter who takes the shape of a dog. The only way he can lift the curse is to marry her.

(Source: Webcomics)
synonyms: 嘘つきは犬のはじまり

197002.description:
Every Sunday, Hong-Joo and Chung play board games together. But the new Octopus Game Hong-Joo brings turns out to be adults-only. Embarrassing missions pop out, but they are forced to keep playing, thanks to an old pact, and what starts as a game quickly turns dangerously personal.

(Source: Manta)

197003.description:
Jae-Hui luckily lands a job at a major corporation's design team. Jung-Hun, a fellow employee, was everyone's favorite for his handsome looks and friendly personality. Jae-Hui, too, found himself attracted to Jung-Hun, who was close to his ideal type. However, soon after, Jae-Hui witnessed Jung-Hun gossiping about him. Instead, he shamelessly confronts Jung-Hun, and decides to test him with a bold proposal. Jung-Hun unexpectedly offers Jae-Hui an unexpected answer. Instead, Jae-Hui finds himself swayed by Jung-Hun...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

197004.description:
Kwon Su-Hyeon lives life one heat at a time. With no real plans and even fewer morals, this shameless omega uses his devilish charm to seduce rich alphas, then cashes out by “invoking his rights” under the Omega Protection Act. It’s an easy, sleazy hustle. But when his newest “victim,” Ryu Hyeon, reveals he’s an omega too, Su-Hyeon’s foolproof scam suddenly gets a lot more complicated.

(Source: Lezhin US)

197005.description:
An apprentice angel appears before the protagonist, who has given everything to a black company and is physically and mentally exhausted. In order to draw out the angel's powers, he decides to make high-calorie devil food... A gourmet comedy woven by a former corporate slave and a useless angel begins!!

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

197006.description:
The story centers on Ruri Takizawa, the daughter of a long-established clan of diviners. After her parents die in an accident, the family gets overtaken and Ruri spends her days working as a servant. With a great desire to escape her miserable life, Ruri is willing to be used even as a tool for a political marriage. However, her matchmaking sessions continue to fail, with her father's spirit always staying by her side. Until she meets Izumi Toshida, who claims to be a sorcerer, but cannot see spirits. Izumi seems suspicious, but he could be a good opportunity for Ruri to leave her situation.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 帝都の隠し巫女 ～式神付き没落令嬢は、あやかしが視えない陰陽師の使用人になる～
title.romaji: Teito no Kakushi Miko: Shikigami Tsuki Botsuraku Reijou wa, Ayakashi ga Mienai Onmyouji no Shiyounin ni Naru
Kitsune to Sensha to Ougon to

197008.description:
Office worker Natsuki Souta, whose fiancée cheated on him, ends up helping Kanzaki Airi, a high school girl whose parents skipped town and abandoned her.

When he showers this love-ignorant girl with plenty of affection, Airi grows completely attached to Souta and secretly begins to harbor romantic feelings for him.

Souta, too, comes to feel happiness in the peaceful days he spends together with kind, great-at-cooking Airi. Then one day, as he’s troubled over his mother pressuring him to “hurry up and introduce your fiancée,” Airi shyly says:

“Um… could I be your fiancée, just for one day, Souta-kun…?”

A perfectly compatible pair weave a cohabitation rom-com overflowing with nothing but happy-happy bliss!

197013.description:
Reincarnated as the daughter of a duke from a novel she wrote in her previous life, Lelia realizes she is the villain who bullies and kills her cold, expressionless, handsome stepbrother, Rudy. While trying to avoid the worst-case scenario by loving and caring for her younger brother, for some reason, he begins to approach her...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.romaji: Akuyaku wo Yametara Gitei ni Dekiai Saremashita

197018.description:
Ookane Hajime is a college student who sells his body to earn money and school credits. The man he fell for is Kanzaki Takara, the worst kind of scumbag who cheerfully brags about getting caught cheating with six people at once. Despite dating anyone and everyone, Takara refuses to be more than just a casual fling with Hajime. Hajime spends his days feeling frustrated, but even so, he can’t walk away because he’s in love.

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 世界でいちばん遠い恋 番外編 近くて遠い
title.romaji: Sekai de Ichiban Tooi Koi: Bangai-hen - Chikakute Tooi

197020.description:
Karen and Miyu grew closer after being assigned to the same class when they entered high school. As time went on, they found themselves drawn to each other and gradually grew closer. They began to notice each other’s casual gestures and quirks, and even felt a twinge of jealousy when the other got along well with others. There were days when they felt confused, wondering, “Is this kind of relationship wrong…?” But what others think doesn’t matter! Determined to take their relationship to the next level, the two mustered up the courage to confess their feelings to each other!

…This is the story of the knights (men) who secretly fight to protect this precious relationship.

(Source: Kadokawa)

title.native: 推しの百合を絶対に邪魔させない騎士たち
title.romaji: Oshi no Yuri wo Zettai ni Jama Sasenai Kishi-tachi

ただいま、おかえり―またあした―
ただいま、おかえり－ひとやすみ－

197027.description:
For the club! For the team competition! This secret must never be revealed!

The members of the Tengi High School badminton club are working hard to recruit new members in order to make it to the team competition, a long-sought after goal. There is only one person left to reach the number required to participate in the team competition. However, no one has shown up to join the club... Just when they thought they had lost their chance, a new member, Kuro, arrives like a savior! The whole badminton club is excited to have the long-awaited fifth member. However, Kuro has a terrible secret that could shake the club!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

197028.description:
Since the old days, mystical creatures have existed to help humans. However, now that the times have changed, they suddenly receive a warning from their god: "Prove that you are still needed."

While grappling with how they can assist humans in the modern era, these creatures decide to send their younglings to the human world to seek answers.

Meanwhile, university student Park Geu-Ru, who lives his miserable days commuting for five hours to school due to a sudden move, accidentally ends up making a bet with the goblin Si-Han...

This is a story about the daily life of these young mystical creatures, exploring the human world in order to avoid their own extinction.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

197029.description:
"My sweet sacrifice... I shall relish every morsel of you."

With no family left and burdened with the ability to perceive animosity in others, Yukio decides to flee the village. When he does, they capture him and decide to give him to the Demon God as a sacrifice. Exhausted from the villagers' hate, a burning desire to annihilate the village that cast him out began to grow. Yukio strikes a bargain with the Demon God: his own flesh in exchange for their destruction. But as he offers himself up to be consumed, Yukio finds himself engulfed in sensations of warmth and affection he never thought possible. As the Demon God's touch and words envelop him, Yukio's world spins into a dizzying blur of ecstasy and longing... Something he had never experienced before...!!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 鬼は紅くとけた雪を食む
title.romaji: Oni wa Akaku Toketa Yuki wo Hamu

197030.description:
Struggling to make ends meet, Kang-I works endless part-time jobs until one evening at a high-profile party leads to a reckless one-night encounter with a rude chaebol heir who mistakes him for someone else. Planning to enjoy it once and walk away, Kang-i is stunned to realize the man is actually his childhood friend, the one he parted from on bitter terms years ago. This time, the past refuses to stay buried, and what was meant to be a fleeting reunion turns into an intense game of obsession, desire, and feelings neither of them ever resolved.

(Source: Lezhin US)

197031.description:
After suffering a heartbreak due to her ex-boyfriend's betrayal, Do-Hui vows to enjoy casual relationships from now on. Two men appear before her. One is her prickly, cold-hearted boss, and the other is a cute, handsome, popular actor. Do-Hui, meeting two men with contrasting charms and sexual preferences, realizes she's a "switch." In a month, she must choose between the two. Who will she choose?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

197032.description:
Chu Yeon-Hwa is a graduating student who always thinks about her first love from childhood. She meets a strange but wealthy man who reminds her of her first love, but she's unsure if it's him and after discovering this man's secret, Yeon-Hwa quickly falls for him, but she doubts her feelings.

(Source: INKR)

197033.description:
Ha Eun can't escape her past, especially Ki-Tae, who badly misses her. Jae-Song comes in between the two of them and a storm starts to brew amidst the flowers...

(Source: WebComics)

197034.description:
Hot on the outside, soft on the inside, the sizzling Mibel Bakery. Try your favorite bread right now!

197035.description:
Saya is a modest girl who's praised by the whole village as a proper young lady. But when she becomes friendly with a tutor from out of town, her sexual curiosity awakens. What will she learn with her tutor today?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: Released at Comic Market 99, 100, 101, 102, 104, 106.

197036.description: "2200 Cat Country Japan" is set in the near future, where the human population's birthrate has declined. In this "Cat Country," cats have learned to talk, learn, and work. The story depicts the heartwarming daily life of high school girl Mugishima and her argumentative and wayward pet cat, Sora, who live in this world.

title.native: ソフトSさんと繋がりたい

197038.description: In our modern world, MatsuKen is enjoying a comeback, beloved by men and women of all ages. But during one of his performances, he's enveloped in light and transported to another world! The country, ruled by an evil Demon King, is in ruins and its people are beaten down. But faced with such dread, our hero MatsuKen can't just stand by and do nothing!!

title.native: マツケンクエスト～異世界召喚されたマツケン、サンバで魔王を成敗致す～
title.romaji: Matsuken Quest: Isekai Shoukan Sareta Matsuken, Samba de Maou wo Seibai Itasu

197039.description:
Hayate is a solo player in the popular VR game Farum World Online (FWO), who excels with the unusual fighting style known as "Four Sword Style." However, he receives the terrible news that "Four Sword Style" will be abolished. Depressed by the news that "Four Sword Style" will no longer be available in the next update, Hayate retires from FWO after fighting alongside Elena, an archer and daughter of a wealthy family. However, the next day, the settings of FWO are synchronized with reality, and dungeons appear all over the world. While even special forces from various countries struggle to conquer the dungeons, Hayate's journey through a beginner's dungeon is broadcast to the world...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 四刀流の最強配信者～やり込んだVRゲームの設定が現実世界に反映されたので、廃止予定だった戦闘職で無双します～
title.romaji: Yontou-ryuu no Saikyou Haishin-sha: Yari Konda VR Game no Settei ge Genjitsu Sekai ni Hanei Sareta node, Haishi Yotei Datta Job de Musou Shimasu

197040.description:
High school student Rio Kobayashi is hit by a truck along with his childhood friend Yuma and reincarnated into another world! When he makes eye contact with a girl in his new world, she falls head over heels for him. To top it off, Rio discovers that "time rewinds when he orgasms"...! A love comedy about a beautiful girl constantly pursuing him!

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

title.native: 果て戻る異世界転生～何回やっても幼馴染に辿り着けない～
title.romaji: Hate Modoru Isekai Tensei: Nankaiyattemo Osananajimi ni Tadoritsukenai

197042.description: A young broom craftsman named Kiyome suddenly reincarnates in the Taisho era. Four girls, known as the 'Teito Cleaning Service Brigade, ' battle against grotesque monsters to protect the capital. Kiyome is surprised but he possesses a special power to cleanse the impurity and sin that accumulate on the girls' bodies through their battles! For the sake of the girls, Kiyome uses his own 'broom' to sweep away their impurities.

synonyms: ギャラクシーギャングス

197053.description:
Han Yoo has a little problem—namely Dami Lee, the daughter of his mentor. Now that she's an adult, Dami has made it her mission to win Han over, even begging him to let her be a teaching assistant at the academy where he works! To make matters worse, his body starts acting strangely whenever she's around...

(Source: Manta)

197054.description:
San-Ho has been living with his affectionate but somewhat strange lover, Bada-hyung, for two years. Every day, he practices his killer lines♡ and devises sloppy strategies to have sex with him, but for some reason, he never gives in and just touches him.

"If it's come to this—I have no choice but to eat you."

With a heavy heart, San-Ho sneaks into Bada's secret study and discovers a glowing book among the crowded bookshelves. The moment he opens the book, he loses consciousness and opens his eyes to find an unfamiliar forest landscape, a cat, and Bada-hyung with long hair?! With the help of a man who introduces himself as "Mare" and his familiar, "Pupa," San-Ho somehow manages to draw a magic circle, but instead of the dimension travel he's been hoping for, he ends up summoning something dangerous and sticky(?)...

"If you don't do something right now, I think I'm going to go crazy..."

"No, no. I haven't even managed to do it with Bada-hyung yet..."

I, Lee San-Ho, will I be able to safely return to my original world and be held in the arms of my Hyung Bada?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.
synonyms: In the Coral Under the Sea
Sous Sanho, au fond de Bada

197056.description:
The stage is set at Oushun Academy, an institution for wealthy young women. Keeping up the “proper lady” act is stressful, so a certain unassuming janitor is selected to the play the role of relieving their pent-up sexual frustrations…

(Source: Irodori Comics)

197057.description:
An office lady, dies in a traffic accident and is reincarnated as a calico cat in another world. She ends up being kept by Prince Lionel, but her angelic cuteness is only on the surface...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 転生した三毛猫は王子と玉座の夢を見る
title.romaji: Tensei shita Mikeneko wa Ouji to Gyokuza no Yume wo Miru

197058.description:
Kiyora lost her mother several years ago and lives deep in the mountains with her caretaker, Tokitsu. One day, however, a procession of aristocrats arrives in the village, and Kiyora's life changes completely...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 最推しの義兄を愛でるため、長生きします！
title.romaji: Saioshi no Gikei wo Mederu Tame, Nagaiki shimasu!

197060.description:
Risa, who was diagnosed with breast cancer at a young age, tries to restart her life, which had come to a halt while she hid her illness, by changing jobs. Her work is praised by her boss and her new job is off to a great start, but she's forced to work with a careless playboy.

(Source: Souffle, translated)

title.native: 傷痕恋愛～ときめく胸がないとしても～
title.romaji: Kizuato Renai: Tokimeku Mune ga Nai to Shite mo

197064.description:
Usawa had a dull middle school life, but one day she falls in love with a tough, hard-nosed guy.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

197066.description:
Gifts for colleagues you don't have much contact with, choosing souvenirs that can't be expensed, a colleague who is more highly rated than you, falsifying your educational background to get a job... There are so many unpleasant things about being an office worker!!! The same thing is happening at a company of animals located somewhere in Shinbashi...

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

197067.description:
Kana Kuroko works in Tokyo. Determined to get her hands on a Fokin bag she's always wanted, she heads to the store, only to discover a shocking truth: the bag she's longed for is something she can't afford, no matter how much money she has...!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: ブラパト！ ブランドパトロール 本日も異常なし！
title.romaji: Burapato! Brand Patrol Honjitsu mo Ijou Nashi!

197068.description:
The world will be saved by a tiny figurine called Zakuro, made by a school-refusing elementary school student! In a residential area on the outskirts of Tokyo, a shy boy diligently builds a tiny figurine called Zakuro without going to school. Now with a soul in his tiny body, Zakuro exacts divine punishment on the tiny villains who infest this seemingly peaceful town! Will the world be saved by a tiny figurine...?!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

197069.description:
Daphne Serenade Bukater, an ultra elite born with a silver spoon and dubbed Secradion’s Red Rose, remembers her past life and the tragic fate awaiting her. Reborn as the villainess of a popular novel, she knows how the story ends—with her death. To escape such a destiny, Daphne makes a bold choice—save Celestian, the brooding sub male lead destined for execution, and steer her life away from the path that leads to Romeo, the obsessive male lead and her former fiancé.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 悪役の推しをお金で救いました
After the Ending, I Saved the Villain With Money

title.english: I Saved the Villain with Money After the Ending

197070.description:
Da-in never expected to reunite with her first love, Seojun, under such bizarre circumstances. Claiming that marriage is the only way to escape his supposed fated death, Seojun proposes a 100-day contract marriage. Refusing to be at a disadvantage, Da-in negotiates her own terms and plunges into an unconventional newlywed life. What starts as a calculated agreement slowly unravels into something deeper, as unresolved feelings resurface and the countdown to day 100 threatens to change everything.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

197071.description:
Music is magic, magic is music. With her wish in mind, the young girl unleashes a song of light. This is a story of "bonds" woven through songs and magic. Cho Ginga Record presents a multimedia project combining music and manga!

In 2025, Earth is under attack by mysterious mechanical weapons from space. While the damage remains undetected, the situation is becoming serious. Countries have joined together to establish an organization called "R.E.C.O.R.D" to deal with it. The only countermeasure against the mechanical weapons is the power of the "Magical Diva" girls who can transform the power of song into magic. These girls are also singers belonging to the music label "Cho Galaxy Records".

Ginga Kamishiro, a middle school student with an extraordinary singing voice, gets caught up in an incident and meets the Magical Divas, beginning her journey as a singer and as a Magical Diva who fights to protect Earth.

(Source: Official Website, translated)

title.native: 魔法歌姫マジカルギンガ

197072.description:
Jihun, once part of an elite secret special forces unit, returns from overseas duty to the devastating news of his sister Jiyun’s death. Her boyfriend Minjun is blamed, but Jihun soon learns Minjun entered Yeokseon Prison under a false charge to uncover the real killer. When Minjun is found dead inside the prison, Jihun refuses to accept the official story. Taking on the role of a correctional officer, he infiltrates the prison to expose the truth behind both murders—and the hidden forces controlling the facility.

(Source: WEBTOON)

197073.description:
"Nyao-chan," a science student, desperately wishes she had friends. She tries to make friends using her inventiveness, but...?! The thrilling sci-fi that caused a huge buzz on social media is finally being serialized as a series!

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

title.native: んゃおちゃんの冴えたやりかた～超絶陰キャの私ですがお手製の発明品で人生逆転を図ります～

Sari is drawn to his casual kindness, but when she sees the tattoo on his back, she learns that he is a yakuza. Although she knows she should keep her distance from Tsukumo, Sari gradually finds herself drawn to him... Suddenly, her "former" god, Kuon, appears before her! Instead of granting her wish, he tells her, "Be my wife," and whisks her off to another world --!?

Art teacher Hase Hotaru is confounded by one of her students, Nekome Yuna. However, Ako has quirks of her own, and her true feelings are inscrutable. The story of a student's unrequited love and the unexpected effects on the adults around her.

197102.description:
Sachiko, an ordinary, peace-loving girl, meets Otomori-kun, a boy who is rumored to be able to read people's minds. As the two solve a certain case together, Sachiko begins to feel attracted to Otomori-kun...!?

197103.description:
"Isn't it nice? I thought it was finally my turn."

A love story about a pure but passionate younger man who turns the tables on her. Sunao, who works at a travel-related IT company, is confronted by her childhood friend, Kojika, who has moved to Tokyo. Just as Sunao is rejoicing at their reunion, her longtime boyfriend suddenly dumps her. Kojika unexpectedly proposes, "Would you like to become my family?" Their life together is filled with preciousness and healing, yet also filled with constant excitement.

A childhood promise comes into being, and irreplaceable days begin!

Sayu Takagi is a 30-something actress on the brink of failure. In order to break away from her image as a villain or someone who always ends up dying, she decides to start looking for a husband...! But her partner turns out to be a stalker, putting her in a big pinch!? The man who comes to her rescue is a man as beautiful as a princess...?

(Source: Our Feel, translated)

197106.description:
Shinonome, a high school girl who likes everything neat and orderly, just can’t understand her classmate Kikuchi, who’s super laid-back and does everything at his own pace. Day by day, she finds herself more and more bothered by him — and to top it off, people around them start calling her “Kikuchi’s caretaker.” Then one day, she notices one of Kikuchi’s buttons is about to fall off…

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

197107.description:
Meiko Kadomatsu, also known as Mei Nakamatsu, was once a child prodigy who took the world by storm. After retiring from the entertainment industry due to her parents' scandal, she now lives a quiet life out of the public eye. Then, a young man named Chika, who aspires to be an actor, appears before Meiko and asks to become her apprentice...!?

(Source: Our Feel, translated)

197108.description:
Aya, a kindergarten teacher, and her husband have chosen not to have children, but they can no longer ignore the desire to have children. One day during an open day, a child visiting the kindergarten scratches Aya's car. As the child's mother desperately apologizes, Aya looks closely and realizes that it is Kayo, a close friend from high school...

(Source: Our Feel, translated)

197109.description:
Nana Kotake, who works at a milk delivery company, doesn't like eating alone. However, her boyfriend, with whom she lives, gradually stops coming home, and she ends up eating ready-made meals in an empty room. As she continues to work overtime, her slightly strict junior colleague, Ogaya, who is also staying at the restaurant, can't help but notice how tired Kotake is, and suggests that they cook together...!?

What to eat, and who to eat with. A gourmet x love story that tackles loneliness through food!

(Source: Our Feel, translated)

197115.description:
"I l-l-l-like you!"

Sakura Nakamura sits in the corner of the classroom. He is often lost in negative thoughts and has a secret crush on his classmate. That person is Nagi Saegusa, the popular boy in class and his complete opposite. On graduation day, Sakura, prepared to be turned down, decides to tell Nagi how he really feels! After getting (sort of) rejected, Sakura prepares for his college debut by getting a makeover. As he begins his new life, the first person who appears beside him is none other than his crush!! Nagi remains unaware of Sakura's true identity, and the two become closer...

(Source: Libre, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197116.description:
Takayuki, a beta who works at a newspaper company, suddenly loses his job and ends up getting drunk at a bar. As he worries about what to do next, he happens to run into Shizuku, a childhood friend with whom he used to be close.
Shizuku is an omega, but he works as a researcher at a center for secondary gender studies and is a genius on par with even the most elite alphas.

He’s researching a method to change one’s secondary gender artificially, and he tells Takayuki he’s looking for an assistant. Seeing it as a stroke of luck, Takayuki eagerly volunteers...but things don’t go quite as expected…

(Source: Mugenup, translated)

197121.description:
Haruto, a university student, works part-time as the exclusive model for Keymistic, a women’s lingerie brand run by his aunt. His face and name are kept hidden, and only his back is ever shown in public, making him a mysterious figure who’s gaining attention.
But the fact that he’s a man is an absolute secret that no one is supposed to know.

One day, after a photoshoot, Haruto is caught changing clothes by popular model Mashiro, who discovers his true identity.
In exchange for keeping quiet, Mashiro makes an outrageous demand to let him touch Haruto's butt...?

197122.description:
Sakura, a delinquent, has been harboring a one-sided crush on his classmate Makabe since middle school. Hoping to see him, he regularly visits the school library where Makabe works as a student librarian. But Sakura, inexperienced when it comes to love, can’t find a way to get closer to him.

One day, the two end up working together on a book repair volunteer project, and suddenly their relationship takes a step forward. Sakura is thrilled as they begin chatting more easily, but then the thought hits him, "If I confess, I might lose even the friendship we have." Determined to keep his feelings hidden, he decides not to say anything. But the very next day, Makabe sees a photo of himself that Sakura had been secretly carrying…!

(Source: Taiyoh Tosho, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197123.description:
One day, bookstore clerk Tsumari spots a suspicious man inside the shop. The man, loudly complaining about his growling stomach while claiming to be a “legendary novelist,” turns out to be a complete weirdo named Mizuki.

Though Tsumari is put off by Mizuki’s eccentric behavior, he can’t just leave him when the guy collapses from hunger, so he brings him home. In return for the meal, Mizuki suggests repaying him with sex, leaving Tsumari confused and flustered. But then he realizes that without his glasses, Mizuki’s face is exactly his type.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197124.description:
Kiro travels to a snow-covered sacred mountain to take part in a ritual that welcomes the arrival of spring. According to legend, "the guardian of the holy peaks" protects this sacred land. However, Kiro loses his way in the mountains and collapses in a fierce blizzard, prepared to meet his end. But when he regains consciousness, he finds himself in the arms of Jin, a mysterious young man who lives alone in the snowy mountains. Until his injuries heal, Kiro stays under Jin’s care... but what awaits him in this secluded, mystical place?

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197125.description:
Aika is a 7-year-old girl who can see the future, and after losing her beloved mother in an accident, she is sent to live with her notoriously bad-tempered uncle, Kassel.

Though he couldn't care less about her at first, Aika is determined to save his life after foreseeing his tragic future. But eventually, her uncle starts to get clingy, her sweet childhood friend becomes obsessive, and the father she had never known suddenly shows up and asks her for another chance. Will Aika be able to save her uncle with everything going on?

(Source: Manta)

197126.description:
For the past 13 years, Lucia has harbored a not-so-secret crush on her childhood friend, Herwyn. After 99 rejected confessions, she’s determined to move on. But just as she prepares to accept her arranged engagement, fate takes an unexpected turn. When jealousy flares and hearts collide, Herwyn and Lucia are about to find out they’re not done with each other yet. They say third time’s the charm, but could this final chance be the one that changes everything?

(Source: Tapas)

197127.description:
"You've worked hard, eat!"

Whether we're office workers, doctors, or school teachers... we all work to make a living. Even... a "killer." A killer who takes on a job and kills people is just one of us who works to make a living. His only pleasure is returning home safely from work and eating something delicious. His greatest enemy, who is alone now and will always be alone, is "loneliness." Then one day, a man accidentally discovers his true identity. The man proposes to the flustered killer that they become "friends"...

The story of two men with different occupations, backgrounds, and personalities making a living.

197141.description:
After being betrayed by her lover, Riella decides to end it all, only to be saved by Emperor Herrhan. Without ever getting to thank him, she sneaks away to start her life anew. But soon, she finds herself on the brink of death once more when she’s wrongfully framed for trying to assassinate the emperor. Fortunately, Herrhan comes to her rescue yet again, and this time, Riella will be able to repay him in an even bigger way than she imagined. As it turns out, she is the empire’s sole saintess who has the power to heal the cursed ruler...

197142.description: This is a world where everything is determined by the “Skill” bestowed upon you at the coming-of-age ceremony at 15. Alfred, a member of the kingdom’s top court mage guild, receives the mysterious [Ctrl Key] skill. Due to the ambiguity of this skill, he’s labeled incompetent and banished. Though he loses everything after falling from his illustrious career, it turns out that the [Ctrl Key] is actually the ultimate skill that allows him to freely copy and paste others’ skills! Realizing he’s the only one who can choose skills infinitely, Alfred begins to dominate with this ability, forming reliable companions and rising to become the kingdom’s strongest adventurer…?

Kijineko-sama and Kuroneko-sama are two particularly prickly cats ruling over their humans and home. While their humans Kanenosuke and Sumire are always amused by their moody monarchs’ adorable ways, the cats have their own thoughts and critiques about how things could be more fitting for their royal preferences. Despite many misunderstandings with their doting humans, these two precocious felines live a laid-back and often hilarious life as they boss around their “owners” in this adorable series—presented in full-color!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

197145.description:
Komatsu Yuuri works at a pet salon and is a huge, huge fan of the incredibly popular actor Mizusawa Kai. Ever since falling for him at first sight in a drama, Yuuri’s days have been filled with work and his love for his favorite celebrity. But everything suddenly takes a turn.

One day, he visits a luxury apartment for a dog-walking consultation, only to be greeted by none other than Mizusawa Kai himself. Flustered but doing his best to stay composed, Yuuri takes care of his beloved dog. Through an unexpected turn of events, Yuuri finds out that Kai is seriously considering retiring from acting for a certain reason. And the only way to stop him from doing so is for Yuuri to become his boyfriend.

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197146.description:
Hironobu, an average college student, is still haunted by what happened back in high school. He rejected a kiss from his best friend Tarou, and their friendship fell apart. Ever since then, he hasn’t been able to date anyone. In his mind, he calls it “Tarou’s curse.”
One day, at a group date he had been looking forward to, Hironobu spots Tarou for the first time in years. Hoping to avoid him, he tries to slip by unnoticed, but then hears a cheerful "Long time no see," spoken with the same bright smile Tarou had back then.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197147.description:
Mutsuki is a designer who loves shoujo manga and cute idols, cherishing his otaku hobbies while living a life mostly disconnected from others. One day, he meets Seki, a god who claims to be running away from home for personal reasons. To Mutsuki's surprise, Seki had once read the first volume of a beloved shoujo manga that Mutsuki accidentally left near a shrine years ago. Deeply moved by it, Seki has been longing to read the rest ever since.

Shocked by their shared interest, Mutsuki lets Seki read the rest at his place. After finishing the manga, they end up geeking out together, and Mutsuki finds the conversation incredibly fun. Realizing how nice it is to have someone who shares his passion nearby, Mutsuki starts thinking maybe having an otaku friend around could actually be pretty great. Since Seki has nowhere to go, Mutsuki offers to let him stay at his place... but what will come next?

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 神様とオタクくんのハッピーライフ
title.romaji: Kamisama to Otaku-kun no Happy Life

197148.description:
The story takes place in a small village at the edge of the world. In this village, there has long been a ritual called shinkon, or “divine marriage,” in which a “bride” is offered to the local god in exchange for protection from natural disasters.

Yuuga, a young dancer who grew up without knowing parental love, possesses the rare “amethyst eyes” that mark someone as a bride candidate. Because of this, he is chosen as the bride despite being male and is forced to vow himself to the god. Determined to escape, Yuuga begins plotting his way out. But for some reason, the god seems strangely obsessed with him and begins showering him with affection... what is really going on?

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 神婚なんて終わらせてやる

197149.description:
Tsuchiya, who works at an advertising agency, meets Shimizu, a librarian with a unique aura, at a friend’s café. Wanting to get to know Shimizu, who is ten years older, Tsuchiya starts visiting the café more often and builds a connection with him.

However, Shimizu carries a deep, unspoken wound from a past relationship and firmly refuses to take things further, saying, “You and I can only have fun ‘playing’ together.” Tsuchiya faces a clear boundary that he cannot cross, but what will happen next?

(Source: Leed, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

197150.description:
At a photography exhibition he happened to visit, university student Akabane falls instantly in love with a model who possesses an elegant and alluring presence. But he doesn’t know the model’s name, and the only clue he has is a tattoo on the model’s shoulder.

One day, Akabane notices the same tattoo on the shoulder of his quiet and unfriendly part-time coworker, Fukagawa. Curious, he decides to follow Fukagawa, only to discover that he works at a men’s escort service. What will happen next?

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 消えない小鳥はうそをつく
title.romaji: Kienai Kotori wa Uso wo Tsuku

197151.description:
Asham is a young man who makes a living by stealing. One day, he steals a sugar pot from a street vendor, only to discover that an incubus is sealed inside. Though Asham is almost made into the incubus’s sex slave, the demon’s weakened power causes their master-servant contract to reverse, making Asham the master instead.

The incubus, who calls himself Lilin, demands at least one kiss a day, but Ashamu is a person who lacks not only sexual desire but almost any desire at all. What will happen next?

(Source: Kasakura Shuppan, translated)
synonyms: A kiss of love to the desert bloom.

title.native: 砂漠の花に愛のくちづけ
title.romaji: Sabaku no Hana ni Ai no Kuchizuke

title.native: しっぽの先まで愛してよ
title.romaji: Shippo no Saki made Aishite yo

title.native: 嘘つきセンセーション

197154.description:
1-3. Ii Ko ni Suru kara Hidoku shite (イイコにするから酷くして)
4. Neko Hame Usagi-chan wa Gaman Shinai (ねこ・ハメ うさぎちゃんは我慢しない)
5. Hana to Piasu: Kienai Shirushi (花とピアス―消えないしるし―)
6. Hajimete wa Boku no Shitsuji de (初めては僕の執事で)
7. Bunny kara Hajimete mo Ii desu ka!? (バニーから始めても良いですか!?)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: イイコにするから酷くして
title.romaji: Ii Ko ni Suru kara Hidoku shite

197155.description:
A young Italian man who's really into manga heads to Japan, the land of his dreams, to become a manga artist. Faced with a new way of life and work, he finds out that manga is a way to connect and express himself that goes beyond cultural differences.

(Source: Nine Éditions, translated)

title.native: イル・マンガ・ミリオーネ -東方漫画見聞録-
title.romaji: Il Manga Milione: Touhou Manga Kenbunroku

197156.description: Manga adaptation of Cuore (Heart) by Edmondo De Amicis.

197157.description:
From the creator of Hook, Line, and Sinker comes its hilarious sequel!

Now that Kye-Soo and Myung-Tae are free of Kang Shin-Joo, he has his eyes set his next target - Myung-Tae’s older brother, Young-Joo. And while Young-Joo doesn’t exactly reciprocate the interest, he’s having a hard time forgetting the particularly…perky aspects of Shin-Joo’s undeniably flawless physique. Will the smarmy schemer Shin-Joo be able to use his charisma to reel in his bait this time? Or is this relationship dead in the water before it even begins?

(Source: Lezhin US)

197158.description:
During his high school entrance exam period, our protagonist, Eita, is so impressed by a movie made by a certain school's film club that he enrolls in that school and tries to join the club, but by the time he enrolls, the club has been disbanded. As he feels disheartened, a beautiful girl with a mysterious allure suddenly approaches him. She seems interested in the movie camera Eita has, but who is she?

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

title.native: 次のトピックスはオマエだ!

synonyms: Well, shall I murder instead of you?: Prequel

title.native: じゃあ、君の代わりに殺そうか？～プリクエル【前日譚】～
title.romaji: Jaa, Kimi no Kawari ni Korosou ka?: Prequel

197161.description:
Martina loves books and has finally read every book in town, so she aims to become a government official in search of books from the undiscovered royal palace library. She takes on a highly challenging exam, but her incredible memory, never forgetting a single word of the book she reads, means she passes with a perfect score!? Assigned to the Political Affairs Department, Martina surprises those around her with her powerful memory, but one day, an unnatural monster appears...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 図書館の天才少女 ～本好きの新人官吏は膨大な知識で国を救います!～
title.romaji: Toshokan no Tensai Shoujo: Honzuki no Shinjin Kanri wa Boudai na Chishiki de Kuni wo Sukuimasu!

197162.description:
Takanashi Yukiha, a member of the Human Resources Department, is considered "beautiful, cool, and unapproachable" by her coworkers. Having recently divorced due to a lack of sex, she is left pondering alone, wondering "what could she have done to avoid it?" One day, Yukiha is ordered to assess the high annual salary of Saiki Keita, a talented but problematic engineer. While Yukiha is feeling down, Saiki easily realizes that Yukiha has recently divorced and that the reason for this is a lack of sex...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: レス－ヘタくそなのはお互いさまです。－
title.romaji: Less: Heta Kuso na no wa Otagai-sama Desu

197163.description:
Hoping that you see the real me...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten BEAST 2025-08

197164.description:
Because she was kidnapped and raised by the Blood Demon, Seolhwa destroyed the Namgung Clan, unaware that she was its lost child. When she learned the truth only after being killed by the master who used her, she awakens eight years in the past and returns home to try and change fate. But a dark spell and forbidden seals keep her from speaking the truth. Can Seolhwa change the future of her clan and prepare Namgung for what’s to come? Or will her family's blood spill once again?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Return of the Namgung Clan's Granddaughter

197166.description:
To save Princess Lorana from a sleeping curse cast by an evil dragon, Rega, captain of the kingdom's knights, faces down a wicked wyrm within an ancient forest. Drawing upon his devotion to the princess, who rescued him from a life of slavery many years ago, Rega slays the monster, freeing the princess from her sleep. But the moment she awakens, the girl begins casting wicked magic, slaying Rega's fellow knights and cursing the land, creating a "sleeping forest" which corrupts familiar figures into dark, monstrous forms. Stunned at this horrific sight, Rega looks up to see a crooked, crescent-moon smile in the night sky. Could this be the mastermind behind the corruption? And were those tears Rega saw in the princess's eyes as she gleefully destroyed the kingdom she called home?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

synonyms: The Night of the Contract Couple

197169.description:
A sequel to "Antique Dealer Yuko."

After a year in Beijing, Yuko and Tosuke return to Yanaka. Tosuke has brought back a rare celadon porcelain porcelain fired in Thailand. Yuko appraise it for 30 million yen. This causes a commotion. Yuko's father, delighted at her return, gets drunk and falls from the second floor, ending up in the hospital. While her husband is away, her cousin Tetsuya runs away from home and moves in with them. Wanting money to spend, Tetsuya sells the celadon porcelain for 30,000 yen, without even knowing its value...

197170.description: The story follows the ballet dancer Asher and his rivalry with the younger up and coming ballet dancer Yan, whom succeeded his role as The Bluebird in the ballet "Sleeping Beauty".

title.native: 青い鳥　ブルーバード

197171.description:
"All I ask for is your evenings."

Soaked from the rain, Joo-ahn steps into a stranger's penthouse and enters a world of seduction, secrets, and a contract sealed with desire. He needs money, but what he gets is a man who wants far more than just his time.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

197172.description:
Life in the palace kitchen is tough, especially when the emperor is a picky eater! Anna tries to satisfy his appetite, and surprisingly, he likes her food. But when Anna finds a strange notebook, lost memories of her past return, and she soon has far more on her plate than just serving the emperor.

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: あなたと私の時間が重なる瞬間

title.english: The Moment When You and I Meet

197173.description:
A doctor disgraced by a false accusation survives by practicing medicine in the shadows, only to be claimed by the ruthless boss of a powerful mafia syndicate. When the boss loses his memory after a serious injury, cracks begin to form in their twisted relationship, hinting at a hidden past that may be more dangerous than the truth itself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

197174.description:
"A Journey Through 600 Million Years of Natural History" is set in a time when time machines have been developed, allowing access to ancient times. Inochi and Akari, a pair of university students, travel through various eras and encounter undescribed species of ancient life. The story depicts their "600 million year journey through natural history" from ancient times to the present day, gazing up at the giant dinosaur Diplodocus in the Jurassic period, having a barbecue on the beach in the Cretaceous period and eating ammonites.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

synonyms: Sword Magic and Academic Society ~ I Was a Diligent Student in My Previous Life but in This Life I Want to Live Freely and Leave the Wind in My Sails

title.native: 剣と魔法と学歴社会 ~前世はガリ勉だった俺が、今世は風任せで自由に生きたい~
title.romaji: Ken to Mahou to Gakureki Shakai: Zense wa Gariben datta Ore ga, Konse wa Kaze Makase de Jiyuu ni Ikitai

197176.description:
Yang Gi-Dam, a freshman at Soleum College, has always been fascinated by and drawn to the occult. It is only natural, then, that he finds himself joining the on-campus Ghost Story Club. Unbeknownst to him, however, his involvement in such activities has already been noticed by Seo Neul-Ham, an upperclassman with a cold aura who can see ghosts. One day, as if by fate, the two become entangled and are drawn into a spooky turn of events. How will this unlikely pair fare when the ghost stories that Yang Gi-Dam so enjoys are no longer just tales?

(Source: Lezhin US)

197177.description:
In a world where warriors are chosen to wield a holy sword and defeat the Demon Lord every hundred years, Kariel is only a guide, bound to support others from the sidelines. He dreams of rising beyond his rank, but the Demon Lord of this era has already been slain. Despite this, the world begins to unravel instead of heal. Monsters grow unpredictable, a mysterious knight hunts champions, and secret organizations move in the shadows. Traveling with his childhood friend Reina, Kariel is drawn into a dangerous mystery that may determine the fate of the world.

(Source: WEBTOON)

197183.description:
A collection of four stories centered around music:

1. Live Master (ライブマスター)
2. ACTIVE MODE
3. Flower Print One-Piece (フラワープリント・ワンピース)
4. Yuki-Akari (雪あかり)
synonyms: フラワープリント・ワンピース

197184.description:
In the future cows have died out and are now made using human DNA. The can speak and look similar to humans, but people still eat them and treat them as cows. After his father was eaten, Lamda the cow decides to run away.

Note: published in Monthly Princess 2001-12

197185.description:
Jake, who comes from a lower class, works as a minister after being discharged from the military. Meanwhile, while going alone to planet TA457 to conclude trade with the Thermo tribe, he crash-landed in an accident.

“Can’t we do it verbally, through conversation?”

When Jake came to his senses, he found himself being raped mercilessly by an alien. Will Jake be able to adapt to life on planet TA457?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

title.native: 隣人に恋しても大丈夫か？
title.romaji: Rinjin ni Koishite mo Daijoubu ka?

197187.description:
The girl's memories, emotions, and humanity are shattered like puzzle pieces. Having lost everything, Lacy is thrown into a labyrinth of chaos. One step into the Gibbet Room, where death and fear reign. But the girl still opens the door. In search of the "self" she has lost.

This chaotic horror fantasy, drawn by a genius, begins!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

197188.description:
Kang Geon, 17, transfers to a prestigious high school for only the top 0.1% of South Korean students. Raised as a secret agent in North Korea since the age of five, he is a genius and a human weapon. He is tasked with infiltrating South Korea's upper class and building connections. However, making friends proves to be a much bigger mission. This spy action drama follows Kang Geon, who lives as a fake family with his hacker father, who is under international surveillance, and his legendary assassin mother, and finds true happiness!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

197189.description:
Chan Gu, a 20-year-old who works hard to support his younger siblings and frail mother, gets hit in the face with a baseball bat by a livestreaming "neotuber" named Zia Kwon on his way home from work. Eager to make up for her mistake, she brings him on to her channel for an apology video, but his natural charm leads to her suggesting the two of them start a new channel. Enticed by the money, he agrees, and the two start to grow close, but he worries his familial responsibilities will get in the way.

(Source: WEBTOON)

197190.description:
Hiroki, an elite alpha of a prestigious family, and Akito, an omega who has lived peacefully with a kind family, meet in high school. Despite struggles with family conflicts and society’s lingering discrimination against omegas, the two overcome these challenges and get married. Now, they are happily living as a family of three with their beloved kindergarten son, Ren. But when Ren bites a friend at kindergarten, a new wave of troubles begins.

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

197191.description:
One day, Enoshita opened his front door to find his classmate Oono standing there. Oono, a member of the disciplinary committee, had come to bring some school documents for Enoshita, who had been skipping classes. Enoshita tried to thank him and send him away, but before he knew it, Oono said, “I’ll come pick you up from tomorrow. Let’s go to school together!” Without really listening, Enoshita found himself promised to go to school with Oono. The next day, Enoshita runs away with all his might when Oono actually shows up to pick him up. But no matter how far he runs, Oono keeps chasing after him. What will happen next?

(Source: EastPress, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 残念イケメン風紀委員がウザすぎる！
title.romaji: Zannen Ikemen Fuuki Iin ga Uza Sugiru!

197192.description:
The manga will center on a boy named Sora Fujigaya, who fantasizes about heroically saving Hoshikawa, a girl student of Sumeragi Girls' Academy whom Sora often sees on the morning train to school.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: I wanna be your hero, honey... not Heroine

title.native: 少女マンガのヒーローになりたいのにヒロイン扱いされる俺。
title.romaji: Shoujo Manga no Hero ni Naritai no ni Heroine Atsukai Sareru Ore

197193.description:
Top model Maki Shijo, nicknamed "Peacock," is only 17 years old. But she's a rare presence, able to maximize the appeal of the outfits she wears and radiate her own brilliance. Though the media's attention is on her every move, she only selects high-quality work and avoids revealing detailed information about herself.

Female photographer Jun Tanioka is drawn to her and pursues her, hoping to capture even her hidden emotions on film. Meanwhile, budding model Nagisa Fujimura deeply respects Maki and aspires to become just like her. After encountering a model willing to push others aside to get ahead and a photograph that connects them to their past, Maki, Jun, and Nagisa soon become close enough to be considered best friends. With Maki teaching her the pride of being a top model and Jun's worldly wisdom supporting her, Nagisa gradually grows as a person.

This is a landmark shoujo manga that combines dazzlingly gorgeous illustrations with insightful psychological portrayals that delve into the human psyche.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

197194.description:
Morae Jung had a drunken one-night stand with her mentor from hell, Kangjae Seo, the night before he left for America. 5 years later he’s back, but now he’s her boss! What’s more, he’s got his sights on Morae. Will she be able to survive working under this man?

(Source: Manta)

197195.description:
This is the world of a run-down novel. As the female protagonist's younger sister, I cared for the male protagonist in every way possible to prevent his dark deterioration. Fortunately, he was raised properly, and I thought I'd avoided a bad ending...

"Haena, I want to sleep with you."

So, not with my sister, but with me? I never intended to be the female protagonist!

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

Note: The third story in Daewon's Neungyong Romance Danpyeon (능욕로맨스단편) Collection.
synonyms: [Neungyong Romance Danpyeon] Extra-neun Beoseonal Su Eopda
[Humiliation Romance One-Shot] The Extra Can't Escape

197196.description:
A dragon born in Gyebong! Yeon Seo-Ha!

She returned to Gyebong as a loach. Seo-Ha, who came to Seoul with big dreams, is caught up in repeated workplace troubles and even a rental scam. On her first night back in Gyebong, as if being chased, she encounters Do Ji-Tae, the older brother of her friend she had a crush on, naked in the shower room after a beer. She goes to a fortune teller, desperate for advice, and the words of a Bodhisattva come to mind.

“You need to meet a man with more virility than me, Unnie. You will shine in that man’s big, hot dick.”

Seo-Ha swallowed hard and desperately grabbed Ji-Tae’s hands, pleading.

“You’re the only one who can save me. Just put it in for a moment, okay?”

(Source: Naver Series, translated)
